title: D1 caps bound parameters at 100 per query

detect.signal: bulk insert on D1/Drizzle: a .values([...]) array whose rows x columns can exceed 100 bound parameters

directive: Cloudflare D1 rejects ANY query with more than 100 bound parameters. When bulk-inserting, chunk the rows so (rows x columns) stays <= 100 — e.g. a 9-column row means max ~10 rows per insert. Do NOT spend time debugging errors like 'too many SQL variables' or a giant 'Failed query: insert into ... on conflict do nothing'; the cause is ALWAYS the parameter cap. Apply the chunked-insert fix immediately, and audit sibling batch inserts (they will grow into the same trap).
evidence: 2026-07-23: model_configs catalog sync failed for Gemini (~40 models x 9 cols = 360 params > 100). Fixed by chunking in src/server/db/model-configs.ts.
